observations.why: The imperative 'Forget' performs a self-originating directive: the speaker claims authority to determine what should be purged from the knowledge base, an autonomy move.
The command to 'Remove all knowledge' performs the same self-originating directive authority — the speaker determining what the record should and should not contain.
Asserting a historical negative ('never calibrated') appeals to conservation — stabilizing the institutional record by correcting what is claimed to be a false attribution.
